summary: Nintendo's Wii Music is a Wii-series music creation game built around Wii Remote/Nunchuk gestures, Miis, and optional Balance Board drum control.

entries.title: Wii Music
entries.definitive_edition: Original Wii disc on Wii hardware or Wii U Wii Mode

emulation.notes: Use original Wii Remote/Nunchuk/Balance Board hardware when possible.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Original Wii hardware with official controllers

primary.version: Original Wii disc on Wii or Wii U backward compatibility
primary.why: Wii Music is designed around Wii Remote, Nunchuk, Mii, and optional Balance Board interaction. Original Wii hardware best preserves the motion-control and living-room performance context; Wii U backward compatibility is the practical official fallback.
primary.how_to_play: Use the Wii disc on Wii hardware or Wii U Wii Mode. Record console, disc region, controller/Nunchuk/Balance Board setup, instrument, song, mode, Mii/band setup, recording/sharing state, and whether Dolphin was used only for comparison.

secondary.exclusive_content: Emulator capture and controller mapping route
secondary.what_to_play: Use only for comparison/accessibility with a legally dumped copy.
secondary.why: Motion-controller fidelity can differ from original Wii hardware.

entries.remaster_caveats: Do not replace with rhythm games such as Guitar Hero/Rock Band; Wii Music is a freeform Nintendo music-creation title.
